checkpoints.description: [1/3] Plan: dependency-free Python CLI expense ledger; package, storage, CLI and tests

impact_assessment.why: Bootstrap a complete, useful first project in the dedicated projects/ workspace
impact_assessment.benefits: Working add/list/summary expense tracker with atomic local JSON storage and a passing regression suite
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new CLI and on-disk schema; dependency: none (stdlib only); concurrency: advisory lock around read-modify-write; state: JSON ledger needs atomic write and backup
impact_assessment.mitigation: Document commands in README, one schema in storage module, <.lock> plus temp+fsync+replace and .bak, unit tests for every command and fault

checkpoints.description: [2/3] Implement package: models, atomic storage, ledger operations and CLI
[3/3] Docs and memory: README, ADR-001, gitignore; prepare Phase 4 gates
[3/3] Phase 4 passed: tests 25/25, hygiene, guidelines and secrets gates green; checklists: passed

[1/3] Fix the three hygiene findings in storage.py; retry os.replace only on PermissionError with exponential backoff; warn when the backup copy or directory fsync fails; failing-first tests for each failure path; [2/3] regenerate .aikit/codebase_map.md, record ADR-002, update README if behaviour text changes; [3/3] run all four Phase 4 gates, smoke-test add/list/summary, commit and push

impact_assessment.why: Tally fails the kit's current Phase 4 gates (hygiene, stale map) and its storage loop predates ADR-146, so continuing from a red baseline would mix new work with old drift
impact_assessment.benefits: every gate passes again; a non-transient replace failure is reported at once instead of after five sleeps; a failed backup or directory fsync is announced instead of silently dropped
impact_assessment.risks: contract: storage behaviour changes only in failure paths, the ledger schema is untouched; dependency: none; concurrency: lock ordering and stale-break rules are unchanged; state: no migration
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first tests pin retry scope and warning paths; a full gate run plus add/list/summary smoke test before the commit; no unrelated file edited

checkpoints.description: [1/3]+[2/3] complete: three silent excepts gone, os.replace retries PermissionError only with backoff, backup/fsync failures warn; four failing-first tests pin the failure paths; ADR-002, README and map refreshed. Phase 4: tests 29/29; checklists: passed

[1/4] Models and ledger: parse_id plus Ledger.edit/remove, with failing-first unit tests for partial edits, missing ids and id reuse; [2/4] CLI: edit ID [--amount/--category/--note/--date] and remove ID, no-field and bad-id paths via the Error/Why/Fix triad, end-to-end tests; [3/4] README commands and examples, ADR-003, refreshed codebase map; [4/4] Phase 4 gates, commit-alone verification, push and task completion

impact_assessment.why: Tally can only append, so correcting a mistake means hand-editing the one JSON file the atomic store protects; the next useful milestone is safe correction by the ids list already shows
impact_assessment.benefits: typos are fixed without touching JSON; ids stay stable and are never reused; edit and remove run under the same lock, backup and atomic replace as add
impact_assessment.risks: contract: two new commands and a new id parser, the ledger schema is unchanged; dependency: none; concurrency: edit and remove are read-modify-write operations under the existing lock; state: remove drops an entry from the live file while the previous version stays in .bak
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first unit and CLI tests for partial edits, missing ids, bad ids and no-field edits; every failure uses the triad; no schema migration; full gates plus commit-alone verification before push

checkpoints.description: [1/4]-[3/4] complete: parse_id, Ledger.edit/remove under the existing lock, edit/remove CLI with triad failures, 18 new tests (47 total), README and ADR-003, map refreshed. Phase 4: tests 47/47; checklists: passed
